title: Is anyone's AC playing the role of "discussion moderator" for ICLR? [D]
summary: According to the guide, they are supposed to encourage reviewers to respond to author rebuttals, yet we've gotten nothing but radio silence. Is anyone else having better luck? submitted by /u/Whatever_635 [link] [comments]
reason: Reddit discussion thread asking whether ICLR area chairs are moderating rebuttals; it reports no new research artifact, model release, business event, policy action, or OSS tool, so no rule covers it.
